notes:
**Canvas comments in the product UI screens** (epic CHR-1248). The old Context-panel comment cards are gone; threads live as pins on the canvas.

- Shell screens (app-shell and the chrome-c-* family): Context panel shows only `comments-count-row` ("1 open comment · shown on canvas", flows to `comments-mode-new`). Where the stage shows the screen frame, pin #1 (human) sits on the Checkout button's top-right corner and flows to `comments-panel`.
- State screens: `comments-panel` (thread open), `comments-mode-new` (comment mode, new thread with mention list), `comments-detached` (detached thread + More menu), `comments-flip-resolved` (popover flips left, resolved pins shown).
- Components: `comment-pin` (default/agent/active/resolved/detached), `comment-popover` (default/detached/resolved/new), `comment-message`, `comment-toolbar` (default/comment/resolved), `comments-count-row` (default/empty); new variants `chrome-btn#primary-compact`, `chrome-menu-item#action-hover`/`action-danger`. Tokens: `comment.*` (human/agent/detached/on), `size.pin` 24px, `size.popover` 320px.
- Copy, geometry and states follow the shipped preview (`src/preview/comment-canvas.js`) where it differs from the mockup.
